lens.speaker: Tanya (team owner)
lens.subject: Should reactions now arrive as one bundle per run, not per-skill messages?
lens.message:
The memory you saved settles how reactions reach a person. You put it this way: "we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person, not one message per skill — a person should get one thing to read, not four". The bundle closes when the run closes, and a skill that misses the close waits for the next run rather than sending on its own. The per-skill option was rejected because it moves the ordering problem onto the reader.

[The reaction delivery doc](docs/reaction-delivery.md) says the opposite of the ruling. Its opening reads: "Each reaction skill sends its own message to the person as soon as it finishes: the refraction, the question and the review each arrive on their own, in whatever order the skills complete. Readers collapse duplicates on their side." After the ruling, that would rest on the bundle instead: one message per run per person, closed when the run closes, with late skills waiting for the next run. The sentence about readers collapsing duplicates on their side is the exact burden the ruling takes off them.

Is that the right way to read what you decided: one bundle per run, and the reader never does the collapsing? If I have it wrong, tell me how.

That doc is the only one in the repo this touches, so nothing else moves.
